value.rationale: Exact all-rank, all-dilation enumeration of the natural newly studied maximal-lattice-segment invariant for canonical uniform-matroid base polytopes, not routine small numerics. The signed-support classification and Ehrhart decomposition reveal an exact degree n-3 (two below the polytope dimension) and an Eulerian leading coefficient, whereas the known general theorem guarantees only eventual quasi-polynomiality.
